title: Print two words
instruction: Use a single `print()` statement to output **Hello Python** with a space between them.

title: Print three things
instruction: Use a single `print()` statement to output three items: **I**, **love**, and **coding** — all separated by commas inside the print function.

title: Print your favorite things
instruction: Print your **favorite food** and your **favorite color** in a single `print()` statement, separated by a comma. You can use any food and any color.

title: Print first and last name
instruction: Print your **first name** and **last name** on the same line using a single `print()` with two items separated by a comma.

title: Mix text and a number
instruction: Use a single `print()` to output: **I am** followed by your age (as a number, no quotes) followed by **years old**.
